title: Only God May Judge
author: Some Guy in a Hat
description: Father Blake Blade is the pastor of St. Patrick's Catholic Church in Boston, Massachusetts. Boston is beset by demons, gangs, and cults all vying for dominance. Father Blake has been given a gift to navigate this new reality: the power of the saints themselves. Help Father Blake take down a troublemaking demon... but he has to make his bishop happy first. This is a short game, and should be pretty easy.
